mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment turns bearish.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE increase and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between GDPC1 decline and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strengthening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a single month signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between HOUST increase and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a single month, it signals inflationary pressure in a low-rate environment, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint effect of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between RSAFS increase and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
